svg.title: Authored sources and compiled bundles
svg.desc: The files a run read, beside the bundles it wrote.

g.text: Moves tracker issues across a project board, from proposal to done, under
the engineering lifecycle the board's owner selects.
Project Lifecycle moves issues across a project board. Each mode is one
The board's engineering lifecycle (its SDLC) decides how the work inside
an issue is planned, delivered and verified.
The board's description records the SDLC it follows as one line, `SDLC:
<name>`. A board recording none follows Ad Hoc. The SDLCs are:
When the board records no SDLC, ask the user which of these it follows,
and record their answer. When the user asks to change it, replace its
line. Refuse any other name, listing these.
Follow the board's SDLC for each practice a mode applies.
Select the mode the user's request calls for:
• **Propose** Raises a proposal on the board.
• **Plan** Moves a proposal from Proposed to Planned.
• **Advance** Moves planned work from Planned to Ready.
• **Deliver** Moves ready work through In Progress to In Review.
• **Sync** Moves reviewed work from In Review to Done.
1. Confirm each dependency of the work is in **Done**.
2. Confirm the work carries a priority.
Moves ready work through **In Progress** to **In Review**.
2. Apply the On Deliver practice of the board's SDLC.
3. Open a pull request for the work.
1. Break the proposal into epics and tasks.
2. Apply the On Plan practice of the board's SDLC.
Raises a proposal on the board.
1. Raise an issue stating the problem and the outcome sought.
Moves reviewed work from **In Review** to **Done**.
1. Apply the On Verify practice of the board's SDLC.
The practice an SDLC applies at each mode step asking for one.
What a plan holds before it is **Planned**.
How work in **In Progress** is built.
What work in **In Review** shows before it is **Done**.
